blocks.text: The hit musical comedy-drama series “Glee” is officially returning, with its original cast members potentially reuniting for the upcoming reboot. The show’s official social media accounts announced the news on Wednesday, Oct. 21, with a teaser that read, “It’s official. Glee is returning.” Disney+ and Hulu have ordered a new season of the series, which will be produced by 20th Television, the studio behind the original show. However, details about the reboot’s plot, cast, production schedule and release date have yet to be announced.
